title: University Website Management
description: Managed and systematically updated content layouts on Parul University's web domains. Analyzed traffic data logs using Google Analytics, implemented SEO modifications, and checked server settings.
architecture: WordPress CMS with custom theme modifications, Google Analytics integration, and on-page SEO optimization across multiple sub-domains.
challenge: Keeping multiple university pages consistent, updated, and optimized for search while working across departments with different content requirements.
solution: Established a content update workflow, created reusable page templates, and set up automated Google Analytics dashboards for traffic monitoring.

title: Responsive UI Development
description: Constructed cross-device responsive modules, layout templates, and interactive component libraries. Focused on speed indices and responsive CSS media structures.
architecture: React component architecture with Vanilla CSS for styling. Mobile-first responsive design using CSS Grid and Flexbox.
challenge: Building pixel-perfect, cross-browser compatible UIs that maintain performance on older Android devices while still feeling premium.
solution: Implemented progressive enhancement patterns, used CSS containment for layout isolation, and wrote lazy-loading image components to defer off-screen assets.

title: Digital Marketing & Social Media
description: Configured marketing tracks, optimized Meta Ads targeting parameters, and built visual campaign media dashboards to increase lead generation.
architecture: Multi-platform campaign structure across Meta Business Suite, Instagram Ad Manager, and Google Analytics for performance tracking.
challenge: Achieving high ROI with limited ad budgets while building brand recognition for clients in competitive local markets.
solution: Developed hyper-targeted audience segments using Meta's Lookalike Audiences, A/B tested creative assets, and optimized bidding strategies based on weekly analytics reports.
